chapter: Boston roadhouses and the Army band
title: Transferring into the Pioneer regiment band under Will Vodery
summary: He gets from headquarters company into the band because he can read, under Will Vodery, and recalls clean-up duty and a 14-piece orchestra.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: How did you get in the band?

See, I could read music, and this guy he was a singer, see, and I was in headquarters company, see when I went there, they put me in headquarters company and I could play the piano and this guy could sing, so then I went to the man and says, hey I want to get in the band, so they transferred me to the band and Bill Vodrey was the Army band leader.
What was the name of the band.
I was in headquarters company, Pioneer regiment and -- from New York.

Pioneer regiment, yeah, they turned it into a Pioneer regiment. We were a regular regiment, see and after we got over there they turned it into a Pioneer, see, we used to clean up. You go into a city and the people, the soldiers were sitting on the sidewalk, you think they were gassed and you would touch them and they would fall over and we had to pick them up.

And I went way back into the, about six miles outside and told the sergeant, that I wanted a job in there, so he put me down peeling potatoes. This was the mess sergeant. I used to peel potatoes and then I'd sneak off and go into my bunk and sleep. The Lieutenant would come by, what you doing, Whaley. I said, I just come off duty. That's all right.
You played piano in the band.

Yes, we had an orchestra, 14 pieces and we went from the -- I remember we were -- the band was going to be detached from the army, see and that's when I went to the Lieutenant and says, is my name on my list to leave. He said 'what's your name?' I said Whaley. He said, yep, so the next morning I picked my -- got up and took my tent down, and the man said, 'where are you going?' The sergeant. I said, 'I'm getting in -- leaving this, I'm going with the band.'
So we went to -- we traveled all over France, see,
